description: Main ports of Europe, Jun. 2020 is a dataset listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eea.europa.eu. The present layer contains the main European ports, including: Core and Comprehensive Ports from the TEN-T network, other ports of relevance (handling more than 1,000,000 tons per year or with a traffic higher than 1,000,000 passengers per year, following Eurostat Statistics 2017) and main fishing ports (with more than 100 fishing vessels registered, according to ... Coverage: Europe. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
